name: Variance Regularization
definition: Regularization on the variance of weight distribution $w(\mathbf{r})$ and color distribution $c(\mathbf{r}, d)$ to decrease ambiguity in low-texture and few-shot regions where weight distribution can vary significantly even if rendered color is identical.
summary: Variance Regularization reduces ambiguity in low-texture regions by penalizing deviations in depth and color variance, unlike standard photometric losses.
